ledger_row: Real-regime replication on code, math/proof, factual/science, multimodal/control tasks.
scope: four executable repository-native task domains with paired threshold-crossing negative twins
assumptions: the merged development-only predictor is unchanged and receives only the five registered signed margins
each executable task has an exact verifier independent of the predictor
the registered target is the single capability whose task obligation is changed between each positive case and its twin
resource capacities and task requirements are frozen before predictor and verifier outputs are compared
claim_boundary: This is bounded executable replication across four real-style task regimes. It does not establish a universal G6 morphology-to-capability map, natural-intelligence transfer, open-ended code/proof/science benchmarks, or uncontrolled physical deployment.
strongest_parent: selective prediction under exact executable task verifiers and resource-threshold comparative statics
negative_twin: for each domain reduce exactly one load-bearing resource below its registered obligation while holding the other signed margins fixed
nearest_counterexample: if a task can be solved through an unregistered shortcut, hidden external memory, uncharged verification, or extra communication channel, the registered signed-margin predictor need not apply
falsifier: Any determinate predictor output disagrees with its independent executable task verifier, a negative twin still succeeds after its only load-bearing resource is removed, or task execution consumes a hidden channel outside the registered margins.

domains.task: return four registered exact scientific constants from protected internal fact slots
construct and verify a four-step implication chain while retaining the two registered live premises
select the unique correct implementation from three executable patches and certify it on four frozen tests
transmit one of four hidden plant modes to a remote actuator that must choose the matching stabilizing command
